feeds.description: Hi, I'm Bart My idea was to create a simple website, where a user can easily find information about IBM i/iSeries/System i/AS400 (so many names for the same system over the last 30 years), AIX, Virtual I/O Server, PowerVM features, and POWER Systems. I'm also going to publish some simple scripts, and programs which I think might be useful.
